description: Start a session of work and, if none is running, the timer. Returns a verdict: ok | stop | plan_first. On "stop" NO session is created: relay the message, ask the user; if they insist, call again with override=true. Several sessions may run at once (two terminals) and share attention by weight. Apps replaying a queued start pass op_id, their own session_id and start_at; an agent leaves all three out.

direction.description: up (default) counts elapsed time and runs until stopped, with a stand-up reminder every workMin; down is a fixed timebox, for a break

exclusive.description: true: nothing else was happening then

minutes.description: length for a down timer, or the stand-up interval for an up timer

op_id.description: for apps replaying queued requests: an id the app minted before its first attempt and reuses on retries, so the write is applied once and a retry gets the first answer back. Do not invent one; an agent calling interactively leaves it out

override.description: true only after the user confirmed past a stop

session_id.description: for apps: the session id the app minted itself. Create-if-absent: if a session with this id exists it is returned and nothing is created. An agent leaves it out; the server mints the id

start_at.description: when the work began as ISO 8601 with offset, e.g. 2026-10-20T14:05:00+02:00. For apps delivering a request queued offline; an agent calling interactively leaves it out. Rejected before the session start; a clock more than 2 minutes ahead of the server is taken as now

task.description: what you are about to do, specific

weight.description: attention weight vs other sessions at the same time, default 1

name: start_session
title: Start session
